description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_DoctypeRegistry, which manages a registry of doctype objects, including registration, retrieval, and creation based on configuration.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_DoctypeRegistry
classes.description: A registry class for managing doctype objects, supporting registration, retrieval, and creation based on configuration.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a doctype object or parameters for constructing one into the registry, handling aliases and doctype storage.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a doctype object by name, resolving aliases, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: make
methods.description: Creates a clone of a doctype based on a configuration object.

methods.name: getDoctypeFromConfig
methods.description: Determines the doctype string from a configuration object, considering various config options.
